When it reached safety, its captain came ashore and handed Elias a brass compass engraved with three stars. “My daughter sent that bottle,” she said. “She dreamed you would find it.”","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一艘停泊在雾里的巨船。高楼只亮着零星窗灯，清洁车缓慢驶过湿润的街道，留下细碎的水声。便利店的店员靠着柜台打哈欠，路口的信号灯仍认真变换颜色，却没有行人催促。远处传来第一班公交车的低鸣，桥下有猫轻巧穿过阴影。早餐铺升起白雾，面包房飘出温暖的香气。天边渐渐泛蓝，沉睡的楼宇显出轮廓，城市在短暂的寂静中舒展身体，准备迎接又一个忙碌而明亮的清晨。","w03":"- Recursion is when a task solves itself by asking a smaller version of the same task for help.\n- Each smaller task keeps doing this until it reaches an easy stopping point called the base case.\n- Then the answers return through all the waiting tasks, like stacked boxes being opened from smallest to largest."}
